name: Male infertility due to sperm disorder
aliases: Male factor infertility due to sperm abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Laboratory Manual for the Examination and Processing of Human Semen (6th Edition)

criteria.description: Sperm concentration below 15 million spermatozoa per mL
Reduced sperm motility less than 40% motile sperm
Abnormal sperm morphology with less than 4% normal forms
Azoospermia confirmed by at least two semen analyses
Abnormal serum levels of FSH, LH, and testosterone supporting diagnosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of oligozoospermia or azoospermia confirmed by at least two semen analyses, supported by clinical and hormonal evaluation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of female partner infertility and other causes of infertility.

pathognomonic.notes: Low sperm concentration in semen analysis
Complete absence of sperm in semen
High percentage of morphologically abnormal sperm

common.notes: Reduced testicular size on physical exam

occasional.notes: Dilated scrotal veins detected clinically or by ultrasound
May be present in hormonal imbalance

laboratory: Semen analysis showing oligozoospermia, asthenozoospermia, teratozoospermia, or azoospermia
Serum hormone levels: elevated FSH, LH, low or normal testosterone
Genetic testing for Y chromosome microdeletions and karyotyping
imaging: Scrotal ultrasound to assess testicular size and varicocele
Transrectal ultrasound if ejaculatory duct obstruction suspected
other: Physical examination findings: testicular volume, varicocele
History of cryptorchidism or genital infections

distinguishingFeatures: Delayed puberty or secondary sexual characteristics
Normal or low sperm count with hormonal deficiency
Evidence of ductal obstruction on imaging or physical exam

redFlags: Complete azoospermia on repeated semen analyses
Rapid onset testicular pain or swelling
Signs of systemic illness or genetic syndrome
references: World Health Organization. WHO Laboratory Manual for the Examination and Processing of Human Semen, 6th Edition, 2021.
Practice Committee of the American Society for Reproductive Medicine. Diagnostic evaluation of the infertile male: a committee opinion. Fertil Steril. 2015.
Orphanet: Male infertility due to sperm disorder (ORPHA:399771)
